segments.text: In this video,

the different ways to open
the Explorer panel will be shown.
In Altium Designer,

the Explorer panel can be opened
in four different ways.
It’s the users choice as to which you prefer.
First, using a keyboard shortcut.

Click the open area
to the right of the project panel.
Press the ‘K’ key
followed by the ‘R’ key.
The second way is from the main menu.
Click View,
then Panels,
then Explorer.

The third way is from the Panels button
in the lower right corner.
Click Panels,
then Explorer.
The fourth way is through the Workspaces list.

Left click on the list of workspaces
at the top right of the screen.

Your available workspaces
may be different than those shown.

You may now select
your workspace.

Open the Explorer panel
to view a sample project.
Navigate to the project and expand it

to display all the documents associated
with that project.

Click on the project to view its details
in the item information area.

The Explorer panel has six distinct
information areas.

The name of the connected
workspace is shown in the upper left.

The navigation path is shown
to the right of the workspace name.

The server folders are shown in the panel
on the left side of the screen.

The item information
area is a large open space

to the right
of the server folder area.

The refresh button will reload
the item information when clicked.

The Explorer panel settings are located
in the upper right corner.
In this video,

we learned different methods
to open the Explorer panel.

title: Altium Training - Workspace Folder Structure: Opening the explorer panel
